description: Source code for handling Git tags, including verification, dereferencing, lookup, parsing, and memory management functions.

methods.name: run_gpg_verify
methods.description: Verifies a GPG signature on a buffer.

methods.name: gpg_verify_tag
methods.description: Verifies a tag object using GPG.

methods.name: deref_tag
methods.description: Dereferences a tag to the underlying object, with optional warning.

methods.name: lookup_tag
methods.description: Looks up a tag object by its object ID.

methods.name: parse_tag_date
methods.description: Parses the date from a tag's string representation.

methods.name: release_tag_memory
methods.description: Releases memory associated with a tag object.

methods.name: parse_tag_buffer
methods.description: Parses a tag from a buffer.

methods.name: parse_tag
methods.description: Parses a tag object from the database.

methods.name: get_tagged_oid
methods.description: Returns the object ID of the tagged object.
